title: RELAY: Selective Self-Distillation with Adaptive Hand-off for Rubric-Based Reinforcement Learning
abstract: arXiv:2610.17623v2 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Rubric-based reinforcement learning grades a response against many written criteria but collapses them into one reward, which discards the detail the rubric carries and gives no GRPO reward gradient when a group's responses tie. A frozen teacher that reads the rubric as privileged context provides token-level supervision, but we observe an early plateau in the gains over GRPO. RELAY uses advantages and rewards to select positive-advantage and low-scoring zero-advantage rollouts, and monitors the distillation loss to decide when to retire the teacher. Stage 1 combines selective distillation from a frozen teacher with GRPO; a plateau detector then removes the teacher, and Stage 2 continues with GRPO alone. Calibrated on one model-domain pair and reused unchanged in three others, the plateau detector fires between steps 122 and 171. RELAY scores highest in-domain among the compared methods in all four settings, ahead of GRPO on RaR-Medici

translated_title: RELAY：面向基于评分标准强化学习的自适应交接式选择性自蒸馏方法
translated_abstract: 基于评分标准的强化学习根据多条书面评分标准对回答进行评分，但会将这些标准压缩为单一奖励，这不仅丢弃了评分标准所承载的细节信息，而且当一组回答打平时无法提供GRPO奖励梯度。一种将评分标准作为特权上下文读取的冻结教师模型可以提供token级别的监督，但我们观察到其相对GRPO的增益会出现早期平台期。RELAY利用优势值和奖励来选择正优势以及低分数零优势的rollout，并监控蒸馏损失以决定何时让教师模型退场。第一阶段将冻结教师模型的选择性蒸馏与GRPO相结合；随后停滞检测器移除教师模型，第二阶段仅使用GRPO继续训练。该方法在一个模型-领域对上进行校准后，无需修改即可在另外三个模型-领域对上复用，停滞检测器在第122至171步之间触发。在所有四个设置中，RELAY在所比较的方法中于域内取得最高分数，领先于GRPO在RaR-Medici上的表现
tldr: RELAY提出一种两阶段训练方法，第一阶段将冻结教师模型的选择性自蒸馏与GRPO结合，并通过监控蒸馏损失的停滞检测器自适应地在最佳时机移除教师模型、切换到纯GRPO训练，从而在基于评分标准的强化学习中超越纯GRPO方法，且停滞检测器跨模型和领域具有良好泛化性。
en_tdlr: RELAY combines selective self-distillation from a frozen teacher with GRPO in stage one, and uses a distillation-loss plateau detector to adaptively hand off to pure GRPO training, outperforming GRPO in rubric-based reinforcement learning with a detector that generalizes across models and domains.
